he responded, “there were three old ladies, the janitor, several thousand archangels, a large number of seraphim, and several million of the triumphant saints of god”. but we always have room for one more! we should always keep in mind the great cloud of witnesses that surround us at every mass. so, on this feast we remember the many good people gone before us whom we’ve met in life and without embarrassment pray to them to help us on our journey . may we join them one day in the communion of saints. registration for children wishing to receive the sacraments of first communion or confirmation in our parish next year 2027 is open on our parish website. register using the link

altar list of the dead. 2025-26. the new altar list of the dead is being complied at the moment. please return your competed lists to the church. thank you to all those who helped in their delivery. spare envelopes and lists are on the tables around the church. the first mass for the new llst will be offered on all souls day, november 2nd, and every first friday in the months ahead. father: “dare we call god father" what is happening after the eucharistic prayer, the priest introduces the our father with a striking phrase we dare to say. dare is ancient and deliberate. calling the creator of the universe “our father" is an audacity made possible only by christ, who invited us into his own filial relationship with god the our father sits here at mass with perfect logic. we have offered, consecrated, and given thanks. now, immediately before receiving communion, we pray as a family — because that is what we are about to demonstrate at the altar rail: one body, one family, one table. how we should respond pray it slowly. these are christ's own words, given to us as a gift when the disciples asked himhow to pray. every line repays a lifetime of reflection - thy kingdom come, forgive us as we forgive, deliver us from evil. none of it is casual. notice too that every petition is plural. not my daily bread - our daily bread. the our father cannot be prayed selfishly. 31st/1st november 2026
